# Copilot Instructions

For project context, architecture, data model, and conventions, see [/docs/CLAUDE.md](../docs/CLAUDE.md).

Always read that file first before making changes so suggestions stay consistent with the established project context.

## Documentation Updates
- Whenever code changes/additions are made to this Unity project, update the relevant docs/*.md files (e.g., docs/DATA_MODEL.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md, docs/CHANGELOG.md, TESTING.md) to reflect what was actually implemented, ensuring Claude/Copilot has accurate up-to-date context in future sessions.
